areaFaqsSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Business Setup in DIFC

items.q: How long does it take to set up a business in DIFC?
items.a: Most businesses are fully registered and operational within 3-5 working days, depending on the license type and required approvals.

items.q: Can I set up a business in DIFC as a foreigner?
items.a: Yes, foreigners can set up businesses in Dubai free zones with 100% ownership. Mainland companies may require a local sponsor depending on the business activity.

items.q: Do I need to be physically present in Dubai?
items.a: Most of the registration process can be done remotely. Our team handles the paperwork and government submissions on your behalf.

items.q: What types of businesses can I set up in DIFC?
items.a: You can set up commercial, professional, industrial, e-commerce, and freelance businesses in Dubai depending on your chosen license type.

quickAnswersSection.title: Quick Answers
quickAnswersSection.subtitle: Common questions about business setup in Dubai. Still have questions? We're one message away.

items.q: How much does it cost to start a business in Dubai?
items.a: Business setup in Dubai starts from AED 9,500 for a basic free zone license. Mainland setup starts from AED 14,500.

items.q: Can a foreigner 100% own a company in Dubai?
items.a: Yes, foreigners can 100% own companies in most free zones and many mainland activities.

items.q: What is the cheapest free zone in Dubai?
items.a: RAK ICC, Ajman FTZ, and SRTIP offer the most affordable packages starting from AED 5,900.

items.q: How long does company registration take in Dubai?
items.a: Free zone registration takes 3-7 business days. Mainland takes 2-4 weeks.

items.q: Do I need a local partner in Dubai?
items.a: Not in free zones. In mainland, many activities now allow 100% foreign ownership.
